name: homeflow
description: Pranava HomeFlow — post-sales OS for residential real estate. Monorepo: apps/ (frontend), services/ (backend), infra/ (AWS CDK), docs/spec (build contract).

scripts.build:static: npm run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const [a,d] of [['workspace','workspace'],['my-pranava-home','customer']]){fs.rmSync('services/api/static/'+d,{recursive:true,force:true});fs.cpSync('apps/'+a+'/dist','services/api/static/'+d,{recursive:true});}console.log('static/ refreshed - restart the api container to serve it')"
scripts.stack:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --build
scripts.stack:test: docker compose exec api uv run pytest
